title: The helix-turn-helix motif in Pseudomonas aeruginosa ExsA monomer can recognize DNA and stabilize the putative ligand-binding domain
authors: Jack Greenhalgh; Prasanthi Medarametla; Antti Poso; Martin Welch; Thales Kronenberger; Taufiq Rahman
one_liner_zh: 该文通过微秒级原子MD模拟研究铜绿假单胞菌转录调控因子ExsA全长与DNA复合物的构象动态，揭示HTH基序驱动单体DNA识别并稳定配体结合域，同时预测可成药口袋，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作机制且采用物理模拟方法，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: Pseudomonas aeruginosa is an opportunistic human pathogen. One of the most potent virulence factors in its arsenal is the Type III Secretion System (T3SS). This secretion apparatus transports effector toxins directly into host cells, thereby causing cell damage or death. Expression of the T3SS is regulated by a master transcriptional regulator, ExsA. To date, no drugs targeting ExsA are available and only static structural models of the protein have been generated, focusing on the C-terminal regulatory domain (CTD). Here, we used µsec atomistic molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to investigate the conformational dynamics in the full-length ExsA (bound to DNA) and in the N-terminal DNA-binding domain (NTD). These data show how the CTD and NTD likely interact with one other. We also subjected the MD trajectories to binding pocket prediction and geometry analyses. This revealed a lipid-binding pocket in the β-sheet bundle and also identified two novel potential druggable pockets at the NTD/CTD interface, which could be used in future structure-based drug discovery campaigns. Overall, a single helix-turn-helix motif seems to drive ExsA monomer DNA recognition and stabilize the putative ligand-binding domain.
abstract_zh: 铜绿假单胞菌是一种机会性人类病原体。其毒力因子中最强效之一是三型分泌系统 (Type III Secretion System, T3SS)。该分泌装置将效应毒素直接转运至宿主细胞中，从而导致细胞损伤或死亡。T3SS的表达受主转录调控因子ExsA调控。迄今为止，尚无靶向ExsA的药物可用，且仅生成了该蛋白的静态结构模型，重点集中于C端调控结构域 (CTD)。在此，我们使用微秒级原子分子动力学 (molecular dynamics, MD) 模拟，研究了全长ExsA（与DNA结合）及N端DNA结合结构域 (NTD) 的构象动态。这些数据揭示了CTD与NTD之间可能的相互作用方式。我们还对MD轨迹进行了结合口袋预测和几何分析。这揭示了β-折叠束中的一个脂质结合口袋，并识别出NTD/CTD界面处的两个新型潜在可成药口袋，这些可用于未来的基于结构的药物发现活动。总体而言，一个单一的螺旋-转角-螺旋基序似乎驱动ExsA单体DNA识别，并稳定假定的配体结合结构域。
